t: Amazon VPC Lattice now supports mutable idle timeout configuration on VPC Lattice Services
Amazon VPC Lattice now supports privately resolvable DNS resources
Amazon VPC Lattice now supports custom domain name for resource configurations
Adds support for specifying the number of IPv4 addresses in each ENI for the resource gateway for VPC Lattice.
Lattice APIs that allow sharing and access of VPC resources across accounts.
This release adds TLS Passthrough support. It also increases max number of target group per rule to 10.
This release adds Lambda event structure version config support for LAMBDA target groups. It also adds newline support for auth policies.
This release removes the entities in the API doc model package for auth policies.
General Availability (GA) release of Amazon VPC Lattice
